run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend since 2026-11-17T08:26:11Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The RequestErrorRate alert on otel-demo/frontend is explained by the ad service becoming unavailable. Frontend error-status spans were 0% of its spans at every 60s point through 08:25:11, then rose to 1.19% at 08:26:11, peaked at 8.51% at 08:35:11 and were still 4.94% at the last reading 08:39:11, consistent with the alert's 08:26:11 onset. The failing frontend operations are its /api/data route and its client call grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds; GET /api/data was at 100% error from 08:27:11 to 08:38:11, while /api/cart and /api/checkout spans stayed at zero errors. The ad service's own server spans (oteldemo.AdService/GetAds, getAdsByCategory, getRandomAds) drop to zero from 08:30:11, after frontend's AdService client spans had kept calling it. Pod ad-554b849958-l9ft5 (owner ReplicaSet ad-554b849958, owner Deployment ad) has container ad not ready, restartCount 4, terminated reason OOMKilled with exit 137, and Deployment ad has replicas=1 with unavailable=1, so there is no healthy ad replica. In namespace chaos-mesh, a Schedule named otel-demo-ad-memory-stress repeatedly spawned StressChaos experiments whose events record 'Successfully apply chaos for otel-demo/ad-554b849958-l9ft5/ad' (first such events returned at 08:24:16, just before the error onset). frontend-proxy shows its own matching error spans on 'ingress' and 'router frontend egress', so it is affected as a caller of frontend, not an independent cause. ad, fraud-detection and recommendation each retained a small steady ~1.05 errors/10m background rate before and during the incident, and accounting and payment stayed at 0, so impact did not widen to the cart/checkout/payment path. The exact chaos stressor size/duration, the alert rule expression and any trace-level error text could not be retrieved; those are gaps, not evidence of absence.

claims.text: Frontend's error share of its own spans was 0 at every 60s evaluation from 08:06:11 through 08:25:11, first became non-zero at 08:26:11 (1.19%), peaked at 8.51% at 08:35:11, and the last returned reading at 08:39:11 was 4.94%, matching the alert's 08:26:11 onset.

Frontend error-status spans are concentrated on span_name values 'GET /api/data', 'executing api route (pages) /api/data', 'grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds', 'GET' and 'tcp.connect'; span_name 'GET /api/cart', 'POST', 'POST /api/cart', 'POST /api/checkout' and both 'executing api route (pages) /api/cart|/checkout' stayed at 0 errors across the sampled window.
For service_name=frontend and span_name='GET /api/data', the error ratio was 100% at every point from 08:27:11 through 08:38:11 (14.47% at 08:26:11), i.e. that route failed completely.

Frontend's client spans for span_name 'grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds' (service_name=frontend, span_kind=SPAN_KIND_CLIENT) continued at about 0.7-0.9 spans/s through 08:34:11 and only then declined to 0 at 08:39:11, so frontend kept attempting the ad call while it was failing.

The ad service's own spans collapsed: service_name=ad span_name 'oteldemo.AdService/GetAds' fell from 0.71 spans/s at 08:26:11 to 0 from 08:30:11 onward, with 'getAdsByCategory' and 'getRandomAds' also at 0 from 08:30:11, i.e. ad stopped producing server-side work at that point.
Pod otel-demo/ad-554b849958-l9ft5 has container ad not ready, restartCount 4, a terminated state with reason OOMKilled and exitCode 137, and lastState.terminated.reason OOMKilled with exitCode 137.

Deployment otel-demo/ad has spec.replicas=1, unavailable=1 and no ready replicas reported, and its container ad has limits memory 450Mi / requests memory 225Mi; ReplicaSet ad-554b849958 is controlled by Deployment ad, so the single ad replica had no healthy instance.

The ad pod's container_memory_working_set_bytes sat at about 354.6 MiB from 08:25:11 to 08:29:11 and then dropped to 175.3 MiB at 08:30:11 and 117.9 MiB at 08:32:11, the restart boundary consistent with the container being killed around 08:29-08:30.

In namespace chaos-mesh the returned events include stress-chaos activity: Schedule otel-demo-ad-memory-stress emitted 'Spawned' and 'Forbid spawning new job because: otel-demo-ad-memory-stress-... is still running' events, and its StressChaos experiments emitted 'Experiment has started', 'Successfully apply chaos for otel-demo/ad-554b849958-l9ft5/ad', 'Time up according to the duration' and 'Successfully recover chaos for otel-demo/ad-554b849958-l9ft5/ad'; the earliest returned chaos events are timestamped 08:24:16, immediately before the frontend error onset.

Pod events for ad-554b849958-l9ft5 in namespace otel-demo are 'Created container: ad', 'Started container ad' and 'Back-off restarting failed container ad in pod ad-554b849958-l9ft5_otel-demo(...)', confirming the crash-restart loop of that container.

frontend-proxy has its own error-status spans on span_name 'ingress' (SPAN_KIND_SERVER) and 'router frontend egress' (SPAN_KIND_CLIENT), rising from 0 at 08:26:11/08:28:11 to about 0.9 spans/s at 08:35:11, so the proxy was failing on its egress calls to frontend.

Other services' error series did not step up: ad, fraud-detection and recommendation each held about 1.05 error spans per 10 minutes both before 08:26 and during the incident, and accounting and payment held 0 across the window, so only frontend and frontend-proxy show a new error regime.
The frontend pod frontend-675fd7b5c5-jfvbx is Running and ready with restartCount 0 and no waiting reason, so the frontend process itself was not crashing or restarting while it reported errors.

Rejected: the cart/checkout dependency chain as the cause. Frontend span_names 'GET /api/cart', 'POST /api/cart', 'POST /api/checkout' and their 'executing api route (pages)' spans show 0 error spans throughout the window, and accounting and payment error series are 0, while the failing route is /api/data and its ad client call.

Mechanism hypothesis: the injected memory stress pushed the ad container past its 450Mi limit between scrapes (working set plateaued at about 354.6 MiB immediately before the kill), and the kubelet OOM-killed it; with only one ad replica and no ready instance, frontend's /api/data (which calls AdService/GetAds) failed on every request, producing the frontend error rate behind the alert.

Open candidate not fully excluded: a runtime flagd override of ad-related flags (adFailure, adHighCpu, adManualGc) injected through flagd/flagd-ui. The flagd-config ConfigMap file shows every flag with defaultVariant 'off', but flagd runtime values set through the flagd-ui container are not persisted to that ConfigMap and were not observable, and none of these flags would by itself produce an OOMKilled container termination.

Review the chaos-mesh Schedule otel-demo-ad-memory-stress (stressor size, duration and interval) and pause it if the memory stress is not intended, since it repeatedly targets the single ad replica's container.

gaps: Chaos-mesh Schedule and StressChaos object specs could not be read (those chaos-mesh kinds are not queryable in this Run), so the injected memory size, worker count, duration and schedule interval of otel-demo-ad-memory-stress are unknown.

The alerting rule RequestErrorRate was not returned by list_prometheus_rules (the rule queries returned status no_data), so the rule's exact PromQL, labels and threshold behind the annotation value 2.622222222222222 are unverified; my own span-share reading was 1.19% at 08:26:11, so the alert's normalization differs from the expression I evaluated.

Jaeger's newest returned trace is about 08:16:27, before the 08:26 error onset; traces_search for service frontend in 08:20-08:30 returned no traces (status no_data) and traces_search_by_tags with error=true for 08:26-08:40 returned no traces (status no_data), so no trace-level error message or parent-child linkage was obtained for the failures.

Application logs did not cover the failure: a fetch_pod_logs query for the ad pod over 08:28-08:43 returned no lines (status no_data), the previous ad container instance was unavailable (HTTP 400), and a filtered frontend log query over 08:25-08:43 returned no lines (status no_data), so there is no app-log confirmation of the ad call failure.

kube-state-metrics series such as kube_deployment_status_replicas_available were not among the 63 metric names returned for this Prometheus, so ad availability was read from the Deployment object's status at query time, not from a metric during the window.

Whether the same Schedule ran stress rounds earlier (which could explain the ad container's restartCount 4 and the working-set rise from 316 MiB at 08:00:11) is unknown: the returned chaos-mesh events only begin at 08:24:16.

Services with no ERROR-status series returned (cart, checkout, currency, email, image-provider, product-catalog, quote, shipping, kafka, load-generator) are unknown rather than verified at zero, and metric-name queries for error-named series returned nothing (status no_data).
No user-facing or downstream impact beyond the proxy/frontend request path was measured, so any customer impact claim remains unverified.
next_steps: Inspect the chaos-mesh Schedule otel-demo-ad-memory-stress and its StressChaos experiments (memory stressors, duration, schedule) to confirm the injected parameters.
Check the Alertmanager/Prometheus rule definition of RequestErrorRate to confirm which metric and normalization produce the 2.6222 value.
Consider raising the ad container memory limit above 450Mi or adding a second ad replica so a single OOMKilled container does not remove all ad capacity.
Verify whether flagd runtime flag values were changed via flagd-ui during 08:20-08:30, since the persisted ConfigMap only shows file defaults.
